text_block_list.name: Legendary Storyteller
text_block_list.text:
The fan voting results for the Arima Kinen 
are in... First place is me! Right away, I 
held a press conference to declare my 
entry, and—

text_block_list.name: Legendary Storyteller
text_block_list.text:
The venue is packed with people, people, 
people!! Heavens... how blessed are so 
many to have found happiness in seeking 
me, the very embodiment of beauty!

text_block_list.name: Legendary Storyteller
text_block_list.text:
To share my joy with my subjects, I 
performed an eight-hour opera of 
gratitude!

text_block_list.name: Legendary Storyteller
text_block_list.text:
And... I hadn't forgotten. The precious 
person who walked alongside me and guided 
me to the throne. —Yes, you.

text_block_list.name: Legendary Storyteller
text_block_list.text:
In return for your devotion, I made a vow. 
That I shall win the Arima Kinen, and from 
that throne—grant you the honor of Best 
Trainer...!
